description:
Public AGPL fork of OrcaSlicer with Full Spectrum mixed-color slicing for the WonderMaker ZR Ultra S toolchanger.

ZR Spectrum is a Windows fork of OrcaSlicer for the WonderMaker ZR Ultra S (a 4-head toolchanger).
It is not official OrcaSlicer. Do not use SoftFever or OrcaSlicer.com installers if you want mixed-color features.
Corresponding Source for this build is git tag zr-2.4.2.1.
